trigger: ingredient source is milk eggs fish crustacean shellfish tree nuts peanuts wheat soybeans or sesame
rule_summary: FDA lists nine major food allergens: milk eggs fish Crustacean shellfish tree nuts peanuts wheat soybeans and sesame
Sesame became the ninth major food allergen in the US effective January 1 2023
app_action: Show US sesame major allergen alert

trigger: ingredient source is a tree nut
rule_summary: FDA requires the type of tree nut to be declared on food labels
app_action: Show specific tree nut name when available

rule_summary: FDA requires the species of fish to be declared on food labels
app_action: Show specific fish species when available

rule_summary: FDA requires the species of Crustacean shellfish to be declared on food labels
app_action: Show specific crustacean shellfish species when available

rule_summary: FDA allows major allergen source declaration either in parentheses after ingredient name or in a Contains statement
app_action: Parse both parenthetical and Contains statements

trigger: may contain or produced in facility statement
rule_summary: FDA says advisory statements such as may contain are not required by law and should not substitute for good manufacturing practices
app_action: Display as precautionary not confirmed ingredient

rule_summary: FDA requires all products containing FD&C Yellow No. 5 to identify it on labels

trigger: total sulfites at or above 10 ppm
rule_summary: FDA says sulfiting agents must be declared when present in food at 10 ppm or more total sulfites

trigger: ingredient source is listed Canadian priority allergen
rule_summary: Health Canada identifies priority allergens including eggs milk mustard peanuts crustaceans and molluscs fish sesame soy sulphites tree nuts wheat and triticale

trigger: priority allergen gluten source or sulphite in pre-packaged food
rule_summary: Health Canada says Canadian labelling regulations require common names for priority allergens gluten sources and sulphite in pre-packaged foods
app_action: Prefer common allergen names in display

trigger: ingredient or additive is sulphite related
rule_summary: Health Canada lists sulphites among key priority substances associated with food allergies and allergic-type reactions

trigger: app calls Open Food Facts API
rule_summary: Open Food Facts asks API users to send a custom User-Agent identifying the app and contact email
app_action: Configure app User-Agent before API use

rule_summary: Open Food Facts documents a read product limit of 15 requests per minute per IP address
app_action: Cache product reads and avoid repeated calls

rule_summary: Open Food Facts documents a search limit of 10 requests per minute per IP address and warns against search-as-you-type
Open Food Facts asks apps that need more than a few hundred products to download CSV or JSONL data instead of using the live API
app_action: Use local database for bulk product coverage
